_comment: Template for a Phase 7 acceptance run. Replace every value with what was
actually observed — the evaluator rejects a run that records no evidence,
and a scenario that was not exercised counts as 'not run', never as a pass.

scenarios.name: duplicate_tab
scenarios.evidence: Opened the same desktop in a second tab: refused with the already-open message; first tab kept drawing. After Switch here, generation bumped and the old tunnel closed before the new one opened.

scenarios.name: force_stop
scenarios.evidence: Admin force-stop on a live session: API returned only after close_and_confirm reported closed; machine went online_free; worker saw the ended message.

scenarios.name: grace_expiry
scenarios.evidence: Killed the worker's network. Lock held for RDP_DISCONNECT_GRACE_SECONDS, coordinator released it on the next tick, Windows left running.

scenarios.name: api_deploy_mid_session
scenarios.evidence: systemctl restart workforce-backend with 12 desktops live: no canvas interruption; claim board recovered after the API came back.

scenarios.name: gateway_loss
scenarios.evidence: Stopped guacamole on gw2. Coordinator marked it down within one tick; new claims placed on gw1; sessions already on gw2 ended and were released by grace.

scenarios.name: coordinator_failover
scenarios.evidence: Killed the coordinator holding the Redis leader key. Second instance took the lease after TTL expiry and resumed grace expiry and reconcile.
